camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-lifecycle --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --allow-same-action-overlap true
description_en: Configures lifecycle rules for a bucket
description_zh: 设置存储空间的生命周期规则
name: PutBucketLifecycle

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether lifecycle rules allow prefix overlap. Valid values:

true: Prefix overlap is allowed.

false: Prefix overlap is not allowed.
parameters.description_zh:
指定生命周期规则是否允许前缀重叠。取值如下：

true：允许前缀重叠。

false：不允许前缀重叠。

parameters.description_en: The container for lifecycle configurations. A maximum of 1,000 rules can be configured.

fields.description_en: The container for a lifecycle rule. The expiration time of an object must be later than the time when the object is transitioned to the Infrequent Access or Archive storage class.
